name: ML2 baseline: hourly available production per turbine

target.name: cf
target.definition: hourly mean power of a healthy turbine in operation, without stops and curtailment (section 3)

output_to_energy: MWh over the horizon = sum over forecast hours of clip(cf, 0, 1) * capacity_kw / 1000 (each row is one hour)
expected_production: expected = available x availability; availability is a per-turbine or per-park history factor, not part of the model
time_column: forecast_time (timestamptz, start of the hour, UTC)
row_unit: one park and one hour; every turbine of the park gets the same weather inputs

ws.care_training_proxy: hourly mean nacelle wind speed (A wind_speed_3_avg, B wind_speed_61_avg, C wind_speed_236_avg)

ws_d1.transform: ws(t) - ws(t - 1 h) within the park's hourly series; NaN for the first hour

ws_sd3.transform: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of ws over t-1 h, t, t+1 h, at least 2 values

temp.transform: temperature_2m minus the park's reference temperature (long-term median at the site)
temp.care_training_proxy: ambient temperature minus the farm median (A sensor_0, B sensor_8, C sensor_7; exact zeros are missing)

wd_sin.care_training_proxy: A sensor_1, B sensor_4; C none

wd_cos.care_training_proxy: A sensor_1, B sensor_4; C none

hod_sin.transform: sin(2 pi h / 24), h = local solar hour = (UTC hour + longitude / 15) mod 24

hod_cos.transform: cos(2 pi h / 24), h as above

doy_sin.transform: sin(2 pi doy / 365.25), doy = day of year of the UTC date (northern hemisphere)

turbine.note: only meaningful for CARE turbines; database turbines are not CARE turbines

unused_forecast_columns.wind_speed_10m: no counterpart at hub height in CARE
unused_forecast_columns.wind_gusts_10m: only a loose counterpart (nacelle 10-minute max); tested as an ablation, not used

ml2_cf_generic.cbm.use: parks and turbines outside CARE (the database fleet)

postprocess: clip cf to [0, 1] before converting to energy
categorical_features: pass turbine and farm as strings
missing_values: NaN is allowed (CatBoost default handling); wd_sin and wd_cos are NaN for farm C
limits: trained on measured nacelle wind, served on forecast 100 m wind: CARE metrics are an upper bound (section 9)
with one forecast row per park, turbines of the same park can only be ordered through what the model knows about each turbine
